directions.glass_current:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: One personal logo direction for Shiv Vyas, software engineer, musician and photographer.
Target dimensions: 1536 x 1024 landscape brand concept sheet.
Reference image: attached website screenshot is mood and compatibility grounding only, not an edit target. Preserve its restrained black #000000, warm white #f8f8f8 and ember orange #f44e00 palette, refined sans-serif typography, generous negative space and modern creative-tech character. Do not reproduce the screenshot or computer.
Primary goal: a distinctive minimal personal mark that feels convincing on this portfolio and independently as an avatar, music identity and photography watermark.
Composition: one large primary logo and tasteful "Shiv Vyas" wordmark on the left two-thirds of a nearly black canvas. Right-hand narrow column: THE SAME exact mark as flat warm-white silhouette on black, then black silhouette on a warm-white square; the small marks are scale/color proofs, NOT alternate logo ideas. Keep same topology. Along the top left place only the exact direction name specified below, small, subdued, readable sans serif. Large margins; professional identity presentation, not UI, not a collage of different ideas.
Constraints: one conceptual mark only. Restrained, vector-friendly silhouette; broad enough strokes and open counters for small sizes. Subtle associations with interests are enough; do not cram three literal icons together. No slogans, fake stationery, stock infinity loops, generic cube, generic tech orbit, existing brand logos or Apple symbol. Render all text exactly. This is an original identity exploration, not a recreation of an existing brand.

Direction name (verbatim): "Glass Current"
Design: An unusually simple, sculpted continuous SV monogram with a flowing rounded S that naturally descends into a decisive V notch. Elegant optical clear glass, subtle silver highlights and just a trace of ember refraction. Three-quarter view with shallow depth, smooth precise bevels; luxurious contemporary industrial design. The silhouette must read as an intentional SV in the flat proofs, not an amorphous blob or infinity loop. Suggest sound through the flowing contour and precision through the angular notch. Use studio light gently; avoid rainbow iridescence and excessive reflections. Brand wordmark "Shiv Vyas" in refined neutral sans-serif.

Direction name (verbatim): "Swiss Ligature"
Design: A flat, authoritative typographic SV monogram constructed from one bold geometric sans-serif stroke system. Interlock S and V elegantly through a single shared diagonal and precise negative space; both letters should be readable. Warm white primary mark with one very small orange cut or offset detail; flat fills, no gradients, no glass, no shadows, no 3D. Visual personality: Swiss editorial restraint, durable modernist geometry, quiet confidence. Optical balance, crisp edges and spacious counters matter more than clever complexity. The wordmark "Shiv Vyas" is refined neutral sans-serif. Distinct silhouette, not a Superman shield or generic sports monogram.

Direction name (verbatim): "Isometric Fold"
Design: A small elegant origami-like angular folded band forms a distinctive interlocking SV in a true restrained isometric view. Matte ember-orange anodized metal with just three clearly legible planar faces and soft studio shadows. Precision-machined folds and simple negative space, suggesting building software and composition in photography. The front-facing flat silhouette must preserve the angular SV idea without depending on highlights. No transparent glass, no chrome, no cube, no impossible Escher geometry, no loose disconnected parts. Avoid making a generic lightning bolt. Confident sculptural orange symbol with quiet white "Shiv Vyas" sans-serif wordmark.

Direction name (verbatim): "Signal Signature"
Design: A fluid single-line signature mark that subtly reads as lower-case sv. One confident medium-weight rounded stroke: an S-shaped waveform flowing into a clean V valley, with generous airy negative space. This is musical, personal and creative, but geometrically disciplined rather than scribbly cursive. Ember-orange flat stroke; no neon glow, no 3D, no gradient, no equalizer bars. At favicon scale it should retain its recognizable expressive outline; avoid hairline details, extra loops, and confusing it with an infinity symbol. Quiet neutral sans-serif "Shiv Vyas" wordmark under it.

Direction name (verbatim): "Aperture V"
Design: A minimal abstract photography-inspired circular emblem built from only THREE broad curved segments, with the central negative space forming an unmistakable V-shaped opening. A subtle flowing S rhythm appears in the opposing gaps; do not force literal S text. This should feel like a personal optical instrument or creative studio seal, not a stock six-blade shutter icon. Flat ivory shapes on black, a tiny ember-orange segment-edge accent. Crisp large negative spaces, calm circular outline, absolutely no gradients, 3D, camera body, lens illustration or orbiting dots. "Shiv Vyas" in tasteful sans-serif. Make the tiny flat proofs distinct and clean.

Direction name (verbatim): "Bracket Cut"
Design: An ingenious developer-oriented SV glyph derived from two bold code-angle-bracket strokes and one compact connecting S-like curved stroke. Integrate the brackets into the actual monogram rather than putting the letters inside literal < >. Sturdy square terminals, 45-degree cuts, warm-white flat fills, one restrained orange terminal. Precision, brevity and strong silhouette, like a custom ligature engineered for a typeface. No box around it, no terminal window, no slash-only symbol, no 3D, no glow, no circuit board. Both S and V should be discoverable in the construction. "Shiv Vyas" wordmark in a beautifully spaced restrained monospace style.

Direction name (verbatim): "Pixel Rhythm"
Design: A compact playful-but-premium SV monogram built from a small number of bold square pixel modules on a precise grid, with stepped S and V letterforms joined as one logo. Pixel structure recalls software, digital photography and a sequencer rhythm. Ember orange as the single primary fill. Chunky, clean, immediately legible geometry with no more than about 16 visible square units and no tiny details. Not a QR code, not an identicon, not a Minecraft object, no perspective, no dithering, no gradients. Warm modern sans-serif "Shiv Vyas" wordmark with normal readable letterforms. Design a recognizable silhouette that remains effective at 24 pixels.
